sections.title: Quick take: best LIC term plan for you

content.text: For most buyers who want low cost + trust, LIC New Tech-Term is the best overall choice (lowest online premium). If you want agent help, consider Jeevan Amar. Avoid Return-of-Premium plans unless you prefer guaranteed return over cost efficiency.
